description: Generate official Standard Form SF-180 (Request Pertaining to Military Records) to retrieve military discharge Copy 4 (DD-214 Member-4) from the National Personnel Records Center (NPRC) in St. Louis for property tax relief.

is_deceased.description: Whether the veteran is deceased (for surviving spouse relief)

requester_address.description: Return mailing address for NPRC delivery

service_branch.description: Branch of Armed Forces (e.g. 'U.S. Navy', 'U.S. Army')

service_number.description: Optional military service number or officer ID

veteran_name.description: Full legal name used during military service

name: generate_sf180_request
